vscode.doctor-failure.monosmith-was-writ: MonoSmith: {name} was written, and smith doctor found a problem with it. smith's steps:
vscode.doctor-failure.commit-anyway-make: Commit anyway makes one commit that Undo can revert.
vscode.doctor-failure.install-tools-fetc: {describeDoctorFailure} Install tools fetches what is missing. Open Health lists every check.{part}
vscode.doctor-failure.install-the-tools-: Install the tools the project needs, with smith tools install.
vscode.doctor-failure.open-the-health-vi: Open the Health view: it lists every check and its remedy.
vscode.doctor-failure.commit-the-files-n: Commit the files now, although a check fails. It is one commit that Undo can revert.
vscode.doctor-failure.leave-the-files-un: Leave the files uncommitted: review them with git, and commit when you decide.
vscode.doctor-failure.monosmith-is-left-: MonoSmith: {name} is left uncommitted. smith remembers its files. Commit them when you decide: run "MonoSmith: Commit the changes…".
